about.title: About
about.bio: I design products and build them with AI agents: spec first, decisions with reasons, every line reviewed, security from day one.
about.project: Strandlight started with one question: what if you could build an instrument out of light, with nothing but your hands? It runs entirely in your browser, and your camera never leaves your device.
guide.step1: Show your open palm to the camera.
guide.step2: Pinch: touch the tips of your thumb and index finger.
guide.step3: Keep pinching and pull. A string of light follows you.
guide.step4: Open your fingers. The string stays in the air.
guide.step5: Point your index finger and sweep it across the string.
guide.step6: Now flick fast across it. Sparks fly.
guide.touch3: Keep holding and drag. A string follows your finger.
guide.touch4: Lift your finger. The string stays.
guide.touch5: Swipe across the string to play it.
guide.hint.camera: Tip: sit 40–60 cm from the camera, with light on your hand.
guide.hint.pinch: Tip: press the two fingertips firmly together, like holding a thread.
guide.hint.pull: Tip: move slowly while pinching, and open your fingers only at the end.
guide.hint.pluck: Tip: go all the way through the string, not just up to it.
guide.hint.touch: Tip: hold still for a moment before you start dragging.
help.subtitle: Every gesture, shown by a hand.
help.card.draw.title: Draw a string
help.card.draw.text: Pinch, pull, then open your fingers. Length sets the sound.
help.card.pluck.title: Play
help.card.pluck.text: Sweep your index finger through a string. Faster is louder.
help.card.flick.title: Flick
help.card.flick.text: A quick flick near a string sends sparks along it.
help.card.stretch.title: Move & stretch
help.card.stretch.text: Pinch the end of a string and drag it. The note bends.
help.card.palm.title: Sustain
help.card.palm.text: Hold an open palm still for one second. Notes ring longer.
help.card.pad.title: Chord
help.card.pad.text: Show both hands. Threads between your fingertips play a chord.
help.sound.title: Length sets the sound
help.tips.title: Tips
help.tip1: Light in front of you, not behind.
help.tip2: Keep your hand 40–60 cm from the camera.
help.tip3: A plain background helps the tracking.
help.tip4: No camera? Press and hold, then drag to draw. Swipe to play.
help.card.mute.title: Mute
help.card.mute.text: Make a V with your index and middle finger and hold it for half a second.
